from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
path=root/'reports/runs/recovery_mapping_20261014/mapping_analysis.json'
def reject_duplicates(pairs):
 result={}
 for key,value in pairs:
  if key in result:raise ValueError('duplicate JSON key: '+key)
  result[key]=value
 return result
obj=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),object_pairs_hook=reject_duplicates)
r=obj['recovery'];packages=r['work_packages'];slices=r['capability_slices'];originals=obj['original_contract_snapshot'];aggregation=r['original_task_aggregation'];order=r['execution_order']
assert set(aggregation)==set(originals)=={f'T{i:02}' for i in range(60)}
assert len(slices)==110
assert len(order)==len(set(order))==26
assert sum(len(t['acceptance_cases']) for t in originals.values())==360
assert sum(len(t['implementation_steps']) for t in originals.values())==360
for tid,task in originals.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/task['acceptance_contract']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==task['contract_sha256'],tid+' original card changed'
 assert task['depends_on']==aggregation[tid]['final_dependencies']
 assert aggregation[tid]['acceptance_case_ids']==[f'{tid}-C{i:02}' for i in range(1,7)]
 assert set(aggregation[tid]['required_slices'])=={sid for sid,s in slices.items() if s['original_task']==tid}
for rid,pkg in packages.items():
 for dep in pkg['depends_on']:assert order.index(dep)<order.index(rid),(rid,dep)
 for sid in pkg['requires_slices']:
  assert sid in slices,(rid,sid)
  assert order.index(slices[sid]['work_package'])<order.index(rid),(rid,sid)
 assert set(pkg['output_slices'])=={sid for sid,s in slices.items() if s['work_package']==rid}
assert aggregation['T55']['required_slices']==['R24-A:T55']
assert aggregation['T56']['required_slices']==['R24-A:T56']
assert aggregation['T59']['required_slices']==['R24-A:T59','R24-B:T59']
assert order.index('R22')<order.index('R24-A')<order.index('R23')<order.index('R24-B')
requirements=json.loads((root/'contracts/requirements.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),object_pairs_hook=reject_duplicates)
assert len(requirements['requirements'])==13
assert sum(x.get('prelim_score') or 0 for x in requirements['requirements'])==100
assert sum(x.get('final_score') or 0 for x in requirements['requirements'])==100
assert len({u for p in packages.values() for u in p['scenarios']})==14
print(json.dumps({'result':'passed','kind':'structural_contract_analysis_only','tasks':60,'original_cases':360,'original_steps':360,'slices':110,'execution_nodes':26,'dag':'acyclic','original_card_hashes':'60 matched','scenarios':14,'requirements':13,'scores':'100/100'},ensure_ascii=False))
